name: VM Chat Message
description: One chat message. Identity is `client_id` (device-minted UUID, idempotency key); ordering is `seq` (per-room monotonic, server-allocated). Never order by creation/modified — they collide within a millisecond and skew across app servers.

fields.label: Seq
fields.description: Per-room monotonic. Allocated under a row lock; unique together with room.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: Device-minted UUID. Makes send_message idempotent across retries.

fields.label: Kind
fields.options:
text
image
video
audio
file
system
ticket
alert

fields.label: Deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. The row stays so seq never has a hole; the body is blanked.

fields.label: Delete Seq
fields.description: Per-room tombstone counter, allocated by VMChatRoom.allocate_delete_seq(). A separate stream from seq so that removing a message never moves the room's unread mark; it is what lets a device that was offline when the message was deleted still learn about it on the next delta sync.

fields.label: Mentions
fields.description: People named with @ in the body. Written by the chat API after checking each is a member of the room.

fields.label: File URL
fields.description: Always a private file. Chat attachments carry EXIF GPS; a public URL would leak it.

fields.label: Duration (ms)
fields.description: Audio/video length, so the client can render a waveform without downloading.

fields.label: Transcript
fields.description: Reserved for speech-to-text on voice notes. Populated by an external provider; empty until that is wired.

fields.label: Vehicle
fields.description: Set by the long-press 'tag vehicle' action.

fields.label: Alert Event
fields.description: Set on messages posted automatically into an alert channel, so tapping one deep-links to the alert.

fields.label: Geotagged
fields.description: False when the device had no location fix or the user denied permission. Never a hard failure.
